title: BOLT: Multi-Bottleneck Bound-Guided Learning for Flexible Job-Shop Scheduling with Time Lags and Resource-Coupled Transport
abstract: arXiv:2610.22433v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Flexible job-shop scheduling becomes resource-coupled when a scarce vehicle fleet moves jobs between stations, because the schedule sets the transport waits. BOLT (bound-oriented learning for transport-coupled scheduling) builds a lower bound from chain, machine-capacity, and fleet-capacity relaxations. The bound equals the makespan at termination, so its per-step changes form a reward that sums to a constant minus the makespan. Because it never exceeds the attainable makespan, each candidate's bound increase is a proven rise of the makespan floor, which the policy reads as a price. The root bound certifies a completed schedule's suboptimality gap without a solver. On industry-motivated 10-module prefabricated-construction instances, explicit transport coupling outperforms a transport-penalty policy in every tested cell where loaded moves occupy at least 66% of fleet time and in none at or below 56%. translated_title: BOLT：面向带时滞与资源耦合运输的柔性作业车间调度的多瓶颈下界引导学习
translated_abstract: 当一支稀缺的车辆车队在工位之间搬运工件时，柔性作业车间调度问题变为资源耦合问题，因为调度方案决定了运输等待时间。BOLT（面向运输耦合调度的下界引导学习）通过链松弛、机器容量松弛和车队容量松弛构建一个下界。该下界在终止时等于完工时间，因此其每一步的变化构成一种奖励，其总和等于常数减去完工时间。由于该下界从不超过可达到的完工时间，每个候选方案带来的下界增量都是完工时间下限的已被证明的提升，策略将其解读为一种“价格”。根节点的下界无需求解器即可证明已完成调度方案的次优性差距。在以工业为背景的10模块预制建筑实例上，在所有装载运输占车队时间至少66%的测试场景中，显式运输耦合方法均优于运输惩罚策略，而在装载占比56%及以下的场景中则无优势。在五个零样本50模块和80模块……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: BOLT通过融合链、机器容量和车队容量三种松弛的多瓶颈下界来引导强化学习，求解带时滞与资源耦合运输的柔性作业车间调度问题，无需求解器即可认证调度方案的次优性差距，并在运输密集场景中显著优于运输惩罚策略。
en_tdlr: BOLT guides reinforcement learning with a multi-bottleneck lower bound derived from chain, machine-capacity, and fleet-capacity relaxations for flexible job-shop scheduling with time lags and resource-coupled transport, enabling solver-free certification of a schedule's suboptimality gap and outperforming transport-penalty policies in transport-intensive scenarios.
